precision: float64; longdouble reports the same precision on both available environments
notes: The carry-forward total includes a conservative measured allowance for preceding manifest tails.

The extra 60-second charge covers short metadata reads, the failed empty-file inspection, bootstrap packaging tests and manifest hashing. It is an allowance, not an assertion that those actions took exactly 60 seconds.

Documentation and parent-coordination gaps were excluded from numerical execution time. The sequential watchdog was resumed through prehashed procedural continuations; it was not one uninterrupted wall clock.
Memory is sampled at approximately 0.25-second intervals and includes the coordinator plus its numerical subprocess group; the reported peak is a sampled value.
No new numerical model or reference is constructed after the worker was handed to the physical profiling agent.
